title: fix: use stable user IDs across the repository
author: voodoohop
pr_body_excerpt:
## Summary

- Uses immutable GitHub account IDs for GitHub workflow authorization, Polly admins, project routing, app registration, duplicate checks, and app-directory attribution.
- Uses Better Auth `user.id` for generation telemetry, observability, debugging queries, developer aggregation, BYOP ownership, and app-key grouping.
- Stops emitting duplicated GitHub identity in new generation events; legacy Tinybird columns remain only to avoid a destructive schema migration.
- Keeps GitHub usernames where they are display labels, required GitHub API inputs, or part of the public `owner/model` namespace.
- Refreshes stored usernames from GitHub while preserving the internal Pollinations identity.

## Validation

- `npm run typecheck` in `gen.pollinations.ai`
- Focused image routing and realtime tests: 21 passed
- Actionlint, Python AST, shell syntax, JSON parsing, Biome, and Tinybird formatting passed
- All 143 changed Grafana queries parsed against production Tinybird; both changed endpoint queries returned expected columns and rows

## Rollout

- Deploy `app_request_counts.pipe` and `app_top_weekly.pipe` to Tinybird staging, verify, then production. No Tinybird deployment was performed from this branch.

gist.headline: Names change, IDs don’t
gist.blurb: The hive stopped treating a rename like a new person. App registration, project routing, and attribution now follow the durable identity underneath the display name.
gist.summary: Reworked repository identity handling so GitHub authorization, Polly admin access, app registration, duplicate detection, routing, and app-directory attribution use immutable GitHub account IDs, while telemetry and developer aggregation use Better Auth user.id.
gist.impact: Developers can change their GitHub username without losing continuity for registered apps, ownership, routing, attribution, or account-level activity.
gist.visual_concept: Depict identity as a sturdy engraved hive tag that remains attached while a smaller handwritten username label is refreshed. Polli, wearing tiny librarian glasses, carefully files an immutable ID tag into a cozy app-directory cabinet beside code-plants; a CRT monitor robot can display a username label changing while the underlying ID stays constant.
